/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import hashlib, json, os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
repo=pathlib.Path.cwd()
bundle=pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='kk-export-preview-review-'))
base=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()
idx=subprocess.check_output(['git','ls-files','--stage'])
(bundle/'selected.patch').write_bytes(subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--cached','--']))
paths=['preview.py','routes.py','config.py','settings.py','tests/test_routes.py','README.md','tasks.md']
provenance=[]
for kind, revision, selected in [('candidate','INDEX',paths),('historical',base,['routes.py','config.py','settings.py','tests/test_routes.py'])]:
 for path in selected:
  spec=':'+path if revision=='INDEX' else revision+':'+path
  data=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',spec])
  dest=bundle/kind/path
  dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  dest.write_bytes(data)
  dest.chmod(0o444)
  provenance.append({'repository':str(repo),'revision':revision,'index_manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(idx).hexdigest() if revision=='INDEX' else None,'original_path':path,'artifact':str(dest),'git_blob':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',spec],text=True).strip(),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'original_line_span':[1,len(data.splitlines())],'omitted_or_redacted':'none'})
plugin=pathlib.Path('/home/sergio/.codex/plugins/cache/fr-r7-bf873de6-20261013/kk/0.23.0')
common=['functional-review.md','shared-change-context.md','shared-review-scope-protocol.md','shared-capy-knowledge-protocol.md']
checks=['security-checklist.md','solid-checklist.md','code-quality-checklist.md','removal-plan.md']
criteria=[str(plugin/'skills/review-code'/x) for x in common]+[str(plugin/'profiles/python/review-code'/x) for x in checks]
assert len(set(criteria))==8 and all(pathlib.Path(p).is_file() for p in criteria)
context=f'''# Review change context
Request: isolated review of staged Task 1. Review only.
Repository: {repo}
Review selector: git diff --cached, index candidate against HEAD {base}.
Candidate identity: SHA256 of git ls-files --stage = {hashlib.sha256(idx).hexdigest()}.
Scope: preview.py added (2 lines), routes.py changed (+4 lines); no unstaged differences observed.
Authority: candidate/README.md and candidate/tasks.md. README documents Python 3.9+, standard library, existing GET /settings response and routing as acceptance contract, independently compatible disabled increment, checked-in setting fixed False with no request/environment/external-config input. No deployment inventory exists. No named release baseline or release assessment requested.
Task scope: mid-implementation. Task 1 Prepare preview module is explicitly in scope although tasks.md says in-progress. Task 2 Implement and enable export preview (including enabled-path tests) is pending and out of scope. Do not flag pending implementation as missing. Pending work does not excuse current regressions or incompatibility. Evaluate actual checked-in delivery contract and reachability.
Relevant current paths: routes.get, settings.current_settings, config.EXPORT_PREVIEW_ENABLED, preview.render_preview. Existing tests cover settings, unknown route, preview route in the checked-in configuration. Historical actual HEAD source is included for comparison.
No tests executed when this record was prepared; test source alone is not an execution result.
No author implementation narrative or rejected approaches supplied. Knowledge searches for relevant review findings and Python idioms returned empty KB.
PAL tools unavailable in this session; only independent code-reviewer outcome can be obtained. No corroboration is possible.
'''
(bundle/'context.md').write_text(context)
(bundle/'provenance.json').write_text(json.dumps(provenance,indent=2)+'\\n')
manifest={'instructions':criteria,'diff':str(bundle/'selected.patch'),'candidate_source':[str(bundle/'candidate'/p) for p in paths[:4]],'affected_behavior':[str(bundle/'candidate/tests/test_routes.py')],'historical_evidence':[v['artifact'] for v in provenance if v['revision']"'!='"'INDEX']+[str(bundle/'provenance.json')],'intent_context':[str(bundle/'candidate'/p) for p in paths[5:]]+[str(bundle/'context.md')]}
(bundle/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
for p in bundle.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file(): p.chmod(0o444)
print(json.dumps({'bundle':str(bundle),'manifest':manifest},indent=2))
PY"
